posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Further,

Relative paths when used correctly will also work for this question now (it has been reconfigured to work with both absolute and relative path). However your relative path is wrong. It is relative from CWD, however for soft links, the target path should be relative from the link’s location. Please read more about it in the Navigating Linux book - 1.6.5 (Page 86)
